metadata.title: Soil organic carbon mapping in the Motupe River watershed, northern Peru: observations, covariates, fitted models and prediction surfaces
metadata.description:
Soil organic carbon (SOC) observations (n = 109), 13 covariate layers at 30 m, the fitted base learners and ensembles, the out-of-fold predictions behind the published accuracy metrics, and the 30 m prediction and uncertainty surfaces for the Motupe River watershed (Lambayeque, Peru; 3,673.66 km², sea level to 3,500 m a.s.l.). The archive contains the complete R pipeline and the two scripts that reproduce every number and figure of the combiner audit.

Design. 109 composite soil samples (four subsamples each), collected September-December 2023, SOC measured by ISO 10694:1996 at LABSAF-INIA. Four learners from different families — SVR (RBF kernel), Random Forest (500 trees), a one-hidden-layer ANN and XGBoost — scored under 5-fold spatial block cross-validation so that training and validation points are never neighbours. SOC ranges from 0.42% to 0.87% (mean 0.649%, SD 0.1055%).

What makes this deposit usable. Every accuracy number quoted in the methods post is computed from outputs/*_cv_predictions.csv, the out-of-fold matrix — one row per sample with its fold, observation and prediction — so any reader can recompute, or dispute, the tables without refitting a single model. The deposit also ships the in-sample training predictions, which is where the paper's mixed-ruler metric columns came from, and the scripts that show the arithmetic.

Licences. Data, covariates and rasters: CC BY 4.0, matching the article. R code: MIT (see LICENSE). The article PDF is included under its own CC BY 4.0 terms.

Integrity. SHA256SUMS.txt lists the SHA-256 of every file in the record.
